hours: About 200 hours in total, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). One playthrough is enough: no difficulty settings, no mission medals, no mission replay, free roam after the story, no New Game+.

steps.text: Play the five chapters and enjoy the story. Take optional missions as they appear, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars as you go — the 100% checklist is not visible yet, but everything you do now already counts toward it. There are no mission medals, so no hidden objectives to watch for. The only thing to do on purpose in this step is the Chapter 1 meditation (see Missables).
steps.title: Step 1 — Finish the story, do side content as it appears

steps.text: After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Its thresholds are lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable. You only need 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 15 of 18 meditations. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. This step is where most of the grind trophies pop.
steps.title: Step 2 — The 100% Completion checklist

steps.text: By now most trophies should be done. Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands (they are not needed for 100%), the combat and money cleanups, and the five trophies whose triggers are still unconfirmed — check the guides linked on each one, the community cracks them fast. The platinum pops with the last trophy.
steps.title: Step 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

warnings.text: Cheats disable trophies and saving, and the 61 cheats only unlock after the story anyway. Keep trophy runs cheat-free, and save before you cheat.
warnings.title: Cheats disable trophies

warnings.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. The game has 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave slot — PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotating the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup.
warnings.title: No mission replay — save at every chapter

warnings.text: Optional missions marked with black icons and pink letters can disappear after a while, and some quest givers go quiet for stretches of the story, but PowerPyx confirms every trophy-related character comes back later, so no trophy is lost this way.
warnings.title: Optional missions can expire — trophies cannot
